name: Fiction Writing
description: Novel-writing studio for Obsidian: body typography (line height / letter spacing / first-line indent / paragraph gap / font size) unified across editing, reading and focus mode; expanded analytics with dual-axis word & active-time charts, time distribution, consistency, efficiency and goal completion; pure-night focus wallpapers with high-contrast body text and a six-item live HUD. Includes lore highlighting, margin annotations, word milestones, Top-10 lore usage and a 365-day heatmap. Local-first.
author: VRPHU
